limitations: No Referral Pro eligibility link attribution referred-user fee row commission asset distribution timestamp or owned payout was accessed.
The public guide provides percentage commission rates but not the exact payout asset timing rounding minimum threshold clawback or tax treatment.
Referral acquisition content support compliance disclosure legal and operating costs are unproved, so gross commission is not net profit.
Referral activity can be zero and public rates or regional availability can change; accepted status is per independently existing eligible fee, not guaranteed recurring income.
The higher tiers require large quarterly referred trading volumes and new-trader counts and are deliberately excluded from the accepted base floor.

The Binance surface returned WAF challenge HTTP 202 and an empty body to the local direct fetch; the current terms were read from the same official page through the independent read-only web fetch and no raw-page hash is claimed.
